verdict.rationale: Lambda publishes a REST API with a full OpenAPI spec (cloud.lambda.ai/api/v1/openapi.json) covering instance creation/management, cloud-init configuration, and webhooks, and docs explicitly describe launching/managing GPU resources programmatically. Community evidence shows this API being used to build an unofficial CLI/MCP server enabling AI agents to launch and control instances, confirming real agentic usability. Missing for 10: an official first-party SDK/MCP server and clearer top-level API docs (llms.txt and some doc-root openapi paths 404).
